A phrasal verb is a verb combined with a
particle (= an adverb or preposition).
Sometimes the meaning of the phrasal verb is
obvious from the verb and the particle, e.g. sit
down, come back,

Sometimes the meaning is not obvious, e.g.
give up smoking (= stop smoking), carry on talking
(= continue talking).

In group 3, where the verb and particle can be
separated, if the object is a pronoun, it must go
between the verb and particle.

Throw them away. NOT Throw away them.

group 3: with object — verb and up, on, etc. can be separated.

meaning, e.g. The plane took off. He took off
